story: GM charges mandatory $1,500 fee for three years of optional car features
text: I sat right here and said I don't want any TruCoat! We had a deal, here, for $19,500! You sat there and darned if you didn't tell me you'd get me this car, these options, without the sealant, for $19,500! These guys, here. These guys! It's always the same! It's always more! [VIDEO]
> ... TruCoat. You don't get it, you get oxidation problems. It'll cost you a heck of a lot more than $500. [VIDEO]
